# apfsctl v0.2.0-beta.8

This beta improves the guided setup experience and administrator authorization.

- Running `apfsctl` from a terminal requests administrator access automatically; users no longer need to prefix the command with `sudo`.
- Setup progress is written to the console while dialogs and APFS operations run. Passphrases are never logged.
- The completion dialog presents volume status, Finder visibility, encryption, Spotlight, FSEvents, and mount path on separate lines.
- Setup continues to reconcile settings on an existing volume with the same name.

**Beta:** Privileged APFS operations and reboot behavior still need validation on physical macOS devices. Use a disposable volume and keep a backup. Encrypted volumes need to be unlocked after restart. Binaries are unsigned and not notarized.
